title: Duma State is proposed to simplify the change of them when getting married
text:
Deputy Ksenia Goryacheva (“Newcomer”) introduced a bill to the Duma State, which proposes to simplify the mechanism of changing them when the end of a marriage in case one of the spouse wants them to have them. . This has been reported in the press services of the faction.
Now the family code of the Russian Federation stipulates that the husband or wife at their request, choosing the name of one of them is a common name, or each spouse holds their surname, or, unless there is a regulation Different by regional law, adding their surname spouse to their surname.
“To prepare for the wedding, I have faced an unexpected difficulty: If one of the spouse wants to attach the other person's name, but the second time leaving, this cannot be issued immediately. Immediately – you need to change documents through a separate process. To arrange an additional bureaucratic adventure as a challenge.
